label: Cosmetics
description: Player and deck cosmetics across all categories (card backs, sleeves, dice, playmats, and pets), covering catalogue schemas, entitlements, Postgres reversals, and frontend selection rules.
notes: Card backs, sleeves, dice, and playmats have Rust validation, Postgres entitlement/reversal tests, and frontend selector contracts. The pets subdomain remains visibly unqualified until AppearanceSelection, equip/entitlement DB tests, and approved pet assets are wired.

subdomains.label: Card backs
subdomains.description: Default and per-deck card back selection, grants, and refund reversal fallback.

subdomains.label: Sleeves
subdomains.description: Card sleeve selection, grants, and sleeve material/profile contracts.

subdomains.label: Dice
subdomains.description: Dice cosmetic selection and entitlement checks.

subdomains.label: Playmats
subdomains.description: Optional playmat selection, grants, and reversal fallback.

subdomains.label: Pets
subdomains.description: Companion pet appearance slots, entitlements, equip endpoints, and approved pet assets.
subdomains.unqualifiedReason: Unqualified: migration 20261121028300 adds cosmetic kind='pet', profile.default_pet_id, deck.pet_id, and GET /v1/cosmetics/catalogue?kind=pet, but AppearanceSelection (services/application/src/cosmetics.rs) and connected-cosmetics.ts have no pet slot, no pet equip/entitlement DB tests exist, and no approved pet assets are published.
